summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate). Changes: added Update(prologue, algebra) container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update, building the prologue from q.prologue[0] on the empty-request path; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py after prepareQuery and exported from plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the required behaviours. Nothing was run (per instructions), so the new tests and the existing DAWG and prepareQuery tests are unverified. Left unchanged: test/test_dawg.py:322 passes the container to pprintAlgebra inside a bare try/except, so it now prints the container rather than a list. No commits made.
